definitions.explanation: Every level, layer, or stratum of society, an organization, or a structure. Often used to describe the breadth of something that spans all segments.

examples.japanese: ⟦{社会|しゃかい}→社会：01427_shakai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{各層|かくそう}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{意見|いけん}→意見：01303_iken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{集|あつ}めた→集める：01170_atsumeru⟧。
examples.english: We gathered opinions from all levels of society.

examples.japanese: {各層|かくそう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{市民|しみん}→市民：01426_shimin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{参加|さんか}した→参加する：25408_sankasuru⟧。
examples.english: Citizens from all walks of life participated.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦イベント→イベント：09594_ibento⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{年齢|ねんれい}→年齢：01490_nenrei⟧・⟦{性別|せいべつ}→性別：04346_seibetsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{問|と}わ→問う：02299_tou⟧ず{各層|かくそう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{支持|しじ}→支持：12933_shiji⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: This event is supported by people of all demographics regardless of age or gender.

notes:
{各層|かくそう} is a compound of ⟦{各|かく}→各〜：00449_kaku⟧ (each) and ⟦{層|そう}→層：12441_sou⟧ (layer, stratum). It means "every level" or "all strata," referring to different segments of society, an organization, or a structure.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{社会|しゃかい}→社会：01427_shakai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{各層|かくそう}: all levels of society
- {各層|かくそう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧わたる: spanning all levels
- {各層|かくそう}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{支持|しじ}→支持：12933_shiji⟧⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧: supported by all segments
- {各層|かくそう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{意見|いけん}→意見：01303_iken⟧: opinions from all levels

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {各界|かくかい}: all circles/fields (focuses on professional or social spheres)
- ⟦{階層|かいそう}→階層：14577_kaisou⟧: social class, stratum (a single layer, not "all layers")
- {各方面|かくほうめん}: all quarters, all directions (broader scope)

REGISTER:
Formal. Common in news articles, official reports, political speeches, and academic writing. Not used in casual conversation.
